_name: probe-2026-07-29-retest — only what the two fixes changed
_why: The full probe (probe-2026-07-29.json) cost $0.94 and 9 of its 13 cases are unaffected by anything shipped since. This re-runs ONLY the four that the two fixes should move, so a diff against probe-v1 is attributable.

_fixes_under_test.2ef28d8 graph literal masking: repro.cypher_uid_dot failed in probe-v1 with "properties ['SEQ'] do not exist" — the guard read an inlined 'D.SEQ' literal as <var>.SEQ. Should now return the six D.SEQ-220823SHA records.
_fixes_under_test.NEXTSEEK_CC_MAX_BUDGET_USD 0.50 -> 3.00: All three CC turns below died on error_max_budget_usd at 168s / 120s / 77s and produced empty replies, so reingest has never actually been evaluated.

_deliberately_excluded.probe.nhp_seq_engine_q1 / q2: Confirmed 408 twice. No fix shipped for the endpoint split yet, so re-running only re-confirms it.
_deliberately_excluded.probe.harmonize_genotypes: Passed all three turns with real output (188 update rows). Expensive CC, nothing changed.
_deliberately_excluded.probe.xmode_cc_then_ns: Failed, but the fix is still being investigated. Re-run once there is one.

_note_consistency: cons.nhp_sequencing_engine will run anyway: nessie.py sets run_consistency = opts['consistency'] or tier == 'full', and there is no way to switch it off. Two cheap NS turns, ~$0.02, and it re-confirms the 408.
_note: repro.cypher_uid_dot was retired 2026-07-30 (issue #35 review, round 2). Its slot here is now advanced.basic_ndma so the running order keeps a search case. The behaviours it caught stay covered by chat_nextseek/tests/test_graph_canonical_uid.py and test_graph_property_guard.py.

variants.name: Reingest a finished scrnaseq run, target sample type given
variants._asserts: Upgraded 2026-09-17 from route+nonempty only (graded WEAK in docs/nessie-harmonization-reingest-questions.xlsx) to also require a produced artifact and a QA disposition. A container_cc turn's debug payload carries no structured qa/saved_files at all (see NessieAI/tests/nessie_tests/evaluate.py's build_artifact_index docstring) -- only reply/artifacts/cc_raw_files -- and render_qa_for_user (NessieAI/ns/reingest/report.py) never prints the disposition constants CLEAN/SOFT_FLAG/HARD_REJECT verbatim; it prints 'Reingest ready'/'Reingest blocked' plus a per-type 'reingest_<type>' name line. Those are therefore the closest resolvable proxies the harness's field DSL has for 'an artifact whose key matches reingest_' and 'qa.*.disposition in {CLEAN, SOFT_FLAG}'. api_artifact.artifacts.zip follows the documented KNOWN LIMIT that a multi-deliverable CC turn (workbook + map_proposals_*.md) only ever exposes the zip, not a per-file basename.

turns.label: main
turns._disposition_check: 'Reingest ready' in last_reply is the resolvable proxy for a QA disposition of CLEAN or SOFT_FLAG (never HARD_REJECT) across every reported sample type -- render_qa_for_user headers the reply 'Reingest blocked' the moment any type's disposition is HARD_REJECT, 'Reingest ready' otherwise (NessieAI/ns/reingest/report.py).
